/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import gzip,numpy as np
names='AIIamacrine Astrocyte Cone GABAamacrine Horizontal Microglia Mullerglia Retinalganglioncell Rod'.split()
# gene coords from Ensembl GRCh38
D='''RHO 3 129528637 129535344
PDE6A 5 149857953 149945287
PDE6B 4 625559 670782
GNAT1 3 50191586 50197696
NRL 14 24078662 24115026
NR2E3 15 71792638 71818259
SAG 2 233307816 233347055
GNB1 1 1785285 1892292
ROM1 11 62611722 62615116
ARR3 X 70268305 70281840
GNAT2 1 109601407 109619929
PDE6C 10 93612533 93666010
OPN1SW 7 128771755 128775794
OPN1MW X 154182596 154196861
OPN1LW X 154144243 154159032
GNB3 12 6839954 6847393
RXRG 1 165400922 165445355
GLUL 1 182378098 182392206
RLBP1 15 89209869 89222577
SLC1A3 5 36596584 36688335
AQP4 18 26851707 26865820
VIM 10 17228241 17237595
SOX9 17 72121013 72126416
KCNJ10 1 159998651 160070483
CLDN11 3 170418864 170454733
GFAP 17 44903159 44916937
ALDH1L1 3 126103561 126197994
S100B 21 46598355 46605208
AGT 1 230690776 230745576
GJA1 6 121435577 121449739
C1QA 1 22635057 22640201
C1QB 1 22652713 22661637
C1QC 1 22642558 22648122
AIF1 6 31615214 31617025
P2RY12 3 151336843 151384765
TMEM119 12 108589851 108598320
CSF1R 5 150053291 150113372
LST1 6 31581065 31588911
TYROBP 19 35904398 35908318
RBPMS 8 30383636 30572261
SNCG 10 86955753 86963264
THY1 11 119415476 119424985
POU4F1 13 78598362 78603552
POU4F2 4 146638893 146642474
NEFL 8 24950955 24956721
GAP43 3 115623292 115721490
ISL1 5 51383395 51394744
DDIT4 10 72273919 72276039
LHX1 17 36936784 36944612
LHX2 9 124001670 124033301
ONECUT1 15 52755053 52791078
ONECUT2 18 57435374 57491298
CALB1 8 90058608 90095475
PROX1 1 213982711 214041510
VSX1 20 25069941 25082141
GAD1 2 170813213 170861151
GAD2 10 26216251 26304558
SLC32A1 20 38724394 38729372
PAX6 11 31784779 31817967
TFAP2A 6 10393186 10419659
TFAP2B 6 50818702 50847619
SLC6A9 1 43989353 44031767
PRKCA 17 66302567 66810743
CABP5 19 48029383 48044079'''
genes=[]
for l in D.splitlines():
 g,c,s,e=l.split(); genes.append((g,c,int(s),int(e)))
with gzip.open('sample.swap.atac.q2.tsv.gz','rt') as f:
 f.readline(); coords=[]; rows=[]
 for line in f:
  p=line.rstrip().split('\\t'); coords.append((p[0],int(p[1]),int(p[2]))); rows.append([int(x) for x in p[3:]])
X=np.asarray(rows,dtype=float); libs=X.sum(0)
print('gene\\t'+'\\t'.join(names))
for g,c,s,e in genes:
 # overlapping gene +/- 10kb, or nearest bin; use bins with any overlap to expanded gene
 ix=[i for i,(cc,a,b) in enumerate(coords) if cc==('chr'+c) and b>s-10000 and a<e+10000]
 if not ix:
  print(g,'NO'); continue
 # normalized mean counts per 100k? total in intervals CPM
 vals=X[ix].sum(0)/libs*1e6
 print(g+'\\t'+'\\t'.join(f'{v:.2f}' for v in vals), 'bins',len(ix))
PY"
